notes.title: I Heard You! The big balancing update is here! 0.3.11v2
notes.notes:
I want to thank everyone for giving feedback, even when it's not the most constructive :P

If this update changes how you feel about the game, please leave a review / update your review, it would help a lot! :)

That being said, here are the patch notes!


Patch Notes - Version 0.3.11v2Upgrade Improvements
Clicking speed effect increased from 0.05 → 0.075, cost multiplier 5 → 7.5.

Cutting speed effect increased from 0.15 → 0.2, cost multiplier 3.5 → 5.

Ricochet damage upgrade cost multiplier reduced from 3 → 2.

Shiny item chance cost multiplier reduced from 20 → 10.

Cutting speed multiplier tablet upgrade cost reduced from 5000 → 1000.

Filling click damage money cost changed from 250 * 2.5 → 100 * 5.
Quality of Life
Quest for ascending a box implemented.

Item visualizer panel sizing slightly adjusted.

Fixes to bubbles not clicking well when overlapped.

Box thump/opening sound now scales with SFX volume.

Internal data comparison issues fixed.
Balance Changes
Increased base item value from 0.35 → 0.4.

Increased starting clicking speed.

Ricochet now starts off stronger, and should have way more impact early on.

Spike bubbles now launch spikes a bit further by default and move slower.

Metal fillings now always have 1 health.

Increased chance to find shards.

notes.title: Demo version 0.3.10
notes.notes:
Fixed German language being selected for some users, even though localization does not exist yet.

Fixed some of the Russian translations being cut off early.

notes.title: Balance + Localization Patch!
notes.notes:
Save data has been reset!

I apologize for no notice earlier, I was not expecting having to do this! :/

The balancing has hugely been improved though, which should lead to quite a different experience :)



Notable changes:

You can now pop bubbles while a box is being cut open.

Ascending a box is way more powerful than before.

Sped up early power curve

Fixed some rounding and float precision issues

Localization has been added! The game has 5 languages available right now, and will increase as we go.



Thank you for all the support!

-Skye <3
